info.title: TodoBoard API
info.description: Every route this server answers, apart from the pages at /login/*, /join/*, /b/*, /s/* and /print/*. A test fails until a new route is here. A board_id is the board's number or its URL slug. x-required-role is the app role a route needs; x-board-access is the least a caller needs on the board. An API key held to some boards is refused any route whose description says so.

schema.description: One JSON-RPC 2.0 message. Batches are not supported.

405.description: POST is the only method here.

delete.summary: Not supported: sessions are not kept

405.description: POST is the only method here.

post.description: The card's one read-only public link, made the first time and the same URL after that. For the board's owner and editors while the board's allow_quick_share is on. Mints a credential, so it takes a session.

parameters.name: board_id
parameters.description: The board's number or URL slug.

sessionCookie.name: session
sessionCookie.description: A browser session. Its POSTs carry csrf_token in the body. The cookie's name is server.cookie_name.

apiKey.description: An API key, as Authorization: Bearer <id>.<secret>.

shareToken.name: X-Share-Token
shareToken.description: A share link's credential: the part of its /s/ path after /s/. A bad, expired or revoked link answers 404 share_link_invalid.

GuestName.name: X-Guest-Name
GuestName.description: What to call this guest in a card's history. Optional.

E400.description: The request was refused as it stands.

E403.description: Not allowed, or a bad csrf_token.

E404.description: No such thing, it is hidden from this caller, or this feature is switched off.

error.description: A short code such as board_not_found, or a sentence.

detail.description: On push_rejected only: Pushover's own words.

role.description: The effective role: an admin's user-scoped key reports user.

csrf_token.description: Sessions only. Echo it in the body of every write.

login_path.description: The link to hand out, shown in this response only. A credential: treat it like a password.

display_name.description: The key's owner. On the admin list only.

credential.description: Shown in this response only, as <id>.<secret>.

join_path.description: The link to hand out, shown in this response only. A credential: treat it like a password.

shopping.description: Any shop's product link in a card here is looked up, not only Amazon's.

width.description: Pixels on a free-lists board; 0 is the standard width.

status.description: failed: the page could not be read; the link is still kept.

serial.description: The card's lasting number on its board.

doing.description: The middle stage on a staged board. Never set with done.

rank.description: Smaller is more important; 0 is unranked.

rank_place.description: On GET board only: the card's place in the ranking, 1 first, 0 unranked.

rev.description: Send it back in a patch to refuse a stale edit.

price.description: Typed by hand; empty shows the product's.

image_at.description: When a picture was pasted on; null when there is none.

shared_with.description: User id to mode. Only for someone who manages the board.

numbering.description: Empty leaves it to each viewer.

done_placement.description: Empty leaves it to each viewer.

add_placement.description: Empty leaves it to each viewer.

purpose_enabled.description: Left out for a share link showing only part of the board.

purpose.description: Left out while the Purpose section is off, and for a share link showing only part of the board.

notes.description: Left out for a share link showing only part of the board.

rev.description: Moves on every change. GET .../stamp reads just this.

members.description: Empty for a caller who sees only a column or some cards.

allow_quick_share.description: Whether the owner and editors can copy a public link from a card's menu. Only the owner can change it, in a session. Not shown to share-link guests.

people.description: User id to display name, for every id mentioned.

card_only.description: The caller sees single shared cards, not the board.

list_only.description: The one column a column link shows; 0 otherwise.

columns_only.description: A share link showing only some columns.

hidden_lists.description: Column id to open card count, for columns a link shows by title only.

visible_list_ids.description: A board link's columns with cards shown. Empty: all.

created_by_name.description: Who made it. In the list only.

share_path.description: The link to hand out, shown in this response only. A credential: treat it like a password.

quick.description: A card's public link. Only board_id, card_id, mode and this are sent.

pushover_key_hint.description: The saved key, masked. The key itself is never sent back.

ref.description: What a card's labels list points at, within this file.

assignees.description: Names, for reading: an import does not assign anyone.
